_comment: Nickname filter data, read by names.ts. Plain lowercase ASCII (Turkish letters written as c, g, i, o, s, u). Every check runs on three spellings of the name: digits as letters (1 as i), the same with 1 as l, and digits removed; letters may repeat. 'anywhere' words are blocked inside any name. 'whole' words only as a whole name part (split on _ and CamelCase), because they hide inside harmless words (class, grape, Nazim). 'patterns' are regular expressions for variant spellings (dropped or swapped vowels, Turkish stems at the start of a word), tested on every part and on the joined name. 'obfuscatedOnly' words are blocked only when spelled with digits (am1na), because the plain word is also a real name (Amina). 'allow' words are removed before the 'anywhere' and 'patterns' checks (therapist, Scunthorpe, Fickle). 'reserved' blocks impersonation: 'reservedAnywhere' inside any name, 'reservedWhole' as the whole name.
